name: Star Anise
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in typical spice quantities. May have mild antimicrobial properties that could be beneficial for SIBO management.
preparationTips: Use whole pods in slow-cooking dishes and remove before serving
Grind fresh for maximum flavor potency
Toast lightly in dry pan before use to enhance aroma
Store in airtight container away from light to preserve oils
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of iron and calcium
